title: Rhubarb Muffins
directions: Cut washed rhubarb into 1/2" lengths - measure.
Sift flour, bk. pwd. sugar & salt. Make well in centre, pour in slightly beaten egg, oil & milk.
Blend until all ingred. are moistened. Fold in rhubarb.
Sprinkle tops c extra granulated sugar.
Bake @ 350° for 25 min.

title: Oat Pancakes
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups ROBIN HOOD or OLD MILL Oats (375 mL)
1 cup ROBIN HOOD All Purpose Flour* (250 mL)
2 tbsp brown or granulated sugar (30 mL)
directions: MIX oats and milk in small bowl. Set aside until milk is almost absorbed, about 5 minutes.
COMBINE flour, sugar, baking powder and salt in mixing bowl. Stir well to blend.
ADD eggs and oil to oat mixture. Beat well.
ADD oat mixture to flour mixture all at once, mixing until smooth.
POUR batter by 1/4 cupfuls (50 mL) onto preheated, lightly greased griddle. Bake until fluffy and bubbles break on surface. Turn and bake other side. Serve hot with butter and/or maple syrup.
MAKES about 18 pancakes.
notes: A quick, easy, delicious, nutritious breakfast!
* or Substitute ROBIN HOOD Whole Wheat Flour
Tip: Pancakes can be frozen and re-heated in your toaster. Cool completely before freezing.
raw_text:
OAT PANCAKES
A quick, easy, delicious, nutritious breakfast!
1 1/2 cups ROBIN HOOD or OLD MILL Oats 375 mL
2 cups milk 500 mL
1 cup ROBIN HOOD All Purpose Flour* 250 mL
2 tbsp brown or granulated sugar 30 mL
2 tbsp baking powder 30 mL
3/4 tsp salt 3 mL
3 eggs 3
1/4 cup oil 50 mL
MIX oats and milk in small bowl. Set aside until milk is almost absorbed, about 5 minutes.
COMBINE flour, sugar, baking powder and salt in mixing bowl. Stir well to blend.
ADD eggs and oil to oat mixture. Beat well.
ADD oat mixture to flour mixture all at once, mixing until smooth.
POUR batter by 1/4 cupfuls (50 mL) onto preheated, lightly greased griddle. Bake until fluffy and bubbles break on surface. Turn and bake other side. Serve hot with butter and/or maple syrup. MAKES about 18 pancakes.
* or Substitute ROBIN HOOD Whole Wheat Flour
Tip: Pancakes can be frozen and re-heated in your toaster. Cool completely before freezing.
